rajesh: Heads-up — an 8-node TP job intermittently hung during warmup on staging this morning. stack/kv cache look weird.
anya: which model / batch config?
rajesh: gpt-3.5-like, tp=8, pp=1, microbatch=2, global_batch=16. We saw one rank stuck waiting in all-reduce for ~90s then timeout.
dave: can you paste the head of the runtime logs?
rajesh: sure — snippet: ```
2026-03-18T08:12:01Z INFO runtime: selected_kernel=matmul_tiled_v2
2026-03-18T08:12:01Z WARN kvcache: kvcache-sync latency=120ms
2026-03-18T08:12:02Z ERROR nccl: allreduce stalled on ring 3, peer 6
2026-03-18T08:13:31Z ERROR runtime: rendezvous timeout after 90s
```
michelle: interesting that kernel selector picked tiled_v2 — we've seen that increase cross-node comm in some shapes. what sequence length?
rajesh: seq=2048 for warmup. perf-bot: profile summary uploaded to /tmp/profiles/2245678901/flame.svg
anya: can you run the lightweight tracer? `RUNTIME_TRACE=comm,kernel ./run_integ.sh --nodes 8 --tp 8`
dave: quick hypothesis: tiled kernel increases tensor chunking which changes per-step launch timing, creating small gaps NCCL can't absorb => starved ranks. Also kvcache-sync adds jitter.
michelle: do we have traces of per-rank forward time microsecond distribution?
rajesh: attached condensed timings: rank0: 9.8ms, rank1: 9.9ms, rank2: 10.1ms, rank3: 2000ms (stuck), rank4: 10.0ms ...
anya: rank3 obviously lagging. what's on that host? dmesg / GPU ECC?
dave: could be GC/pinning, or kernel fallback hitting a slow path. remind me: kernel_selector uses heuristics based on seq_len and device sm_count — any recent change? michelle: yes we rolled a kernel priority tweak in commit 8f4c2d (last week) that biases tiled_v2 for seq>=1024 to reduce mem-use.
rajesh: rolling repro with commit pinned to before that tweak avoids hang in 10/10 runs. with the tweak it's 3/10 hang.
anya: ok root cause candidate: kernel priority tweak -> tiled_v2 chosen -> changes launch ordering -> increased allreduce tail latency when combined with kvcache sync.
dave: mitigation: revert kernel bias, or add microbatch padding to align launches. try `microbatch=4` or add tiny sleep to balance? (not great)
michelle: also could make kvcache-sync asynchronous per-rank instead of barrier. that would reduce rendezvous pressure.
rajesh: immediate workaround done on staging: pinned kernel_selector to commit HEAD~1 and bumped microbatch -> no hangs so far.
anya: next steps: 1) perf team to run synthetic with seq 512/1024/2048 across configs and collect NCCL traces. 2) eng-runtime to add guard in selector to avoid tiled_v2 when multi-node tp>4 until we validate. 3) schedule deeper kernel microbenchmark.
dave: I'll open a PR to add a runtime flag `--experimental-kernel-bias=false` and add test in e2e to run 8-node quick smoke.
michelle: I'll put a dashboard alert for kvcache-sync > 50ms for multi-node runs.
perf-bot: uploaded artifacts: /artifacts/2245678901/nccl_trace.log, /artifacts/2245678901/kernel_profile.json
rajesh: thanks. I'll keep the staging change for now and run long-run overnight. ping me if it recurs. :thumbsup:
